# netbox_provider_account (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/circuits/provideraccount/):

> A provider account is the account at a circuit provider, which the circuits of that provider are billed to.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_provider_account" "example" {
  provider_id = netbox_circuit_provider.example.id
  account     = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account` (String) The account of the provider account.
- `provider_id` (Number) The ID of the provider associated with the provider account.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the provider account.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `description` (String) A description of the provider account.
- `name` (String) The name of the provider account.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the provider account.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_provider_account.example 1
```
